how_to: Add ONLY places a team member has checked in person. Never add a place from memory or a guess.
category must be one of: police, hospital, clinic, pharmacy, fuel, atm, transit, food_shop, hotel.
lat/lon: stand at the entrance and copy the coordinates from Google Maps (long-press) or a GPS app. Say which in 'note'.
opening_hours uses OpenStreetMap style, e.g. "24/7" or "Mo-Su 08:00-22:00" or "Mo-Sa 09:00-21:00". Leave it as null if you did not confirm the hours.
verified_on is the date you checked it (YYYY-MM-DD). verified_by is the team member's name.
After editing, rebuild the map: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m scripts.build_map

Example entry (copy, then edit): {"name": "...", "category": "pharmacy", "lat": 26.08, "lon": 91.56, "opening_hours": null, "phone": null, "verified_by": "...", "verified_on": "2026-10-31", "note": "Checked on site; coordinates from Google Maps pin"}
